thread:
ops-bot: [ALERT] Service p99 latency breach detected on inference-gateway-eu-west2: p99=5.2s (SLO=1.5s), p95=2.1s. Streaming tail stalls rate +150% on /v1/stream and /v1/realtime. Triggered 2026-03-14T03:21:18Z. Auto-paging oncall.

Aisha Rahman: @oncall paging — Im taking this. seeing client reports of long stalls and reconnect loops.

Liam O'Neill: oncall here. Can you dump the egress metrics and recent LB logs? priority: identify cross-AZ hairpin or NAT error.

ops-bot: Snapshot: TLS handshake retries spiked x4, TCP retransmits increased, NAT ephemeral port exhaustion errors in eu-west2-A, packet drop ~2.2% on AZ peering. Backend model-serving p99 also elevated ~1.8s. Affected customers: several mid-market & 1 enterprise (streaming).

Priya Desai: pulling VPC flow logs + NAT agent now. Running: ```sudo journalctl -u nat-agent -n 500 --no-pager``` and `gcloud logging read "resource.type=nat_gateways AND severity>=ERROR" --limit=200`.

Eve Chen: Im checking LB session affinity and route tables. Early suspicion: LB affinity drift caused connections to be sent cross-AZ when ephemeral ports were correlated with AZs, triggering hairpin and extra TLS handshakes.

Priya Desai: logs: repeated "no available ephemeral ports" followed by SYN_RETRANSMIT and TLS handshake timeouts. Sample: ```nat-agent[2310]: ephemeral_ports_exhausted count=312 start=2026-03-14T03:18:55Z```.

Liam O'Neill: Can we take quick mitigations: (1) divert new streaming sessions to eu-central1, (2) bump NAT port range on eu-west2, (3) enable LB client-ip affinity to avoid cross-AZ? Approve?

Aisha Rahman: Approve all 3. Add: temporarily extend connection keepalive on gateway to reduce churn for reconnects. Also notify SRE on-call for coordination.

infra-bot: Executing regional failover: set route preference eu-central1 weight=100 for /v1/stream. Command: `infractl route set --service inference-stream --region eu-central1 --weight 100` (dry-run -> apply).

Priya Desai: Increasing NAT ephemeral pool: `gcloud compute routers nats update nat-eu-west2 --icmp-idle-timeout=30s --min-ports-per-vm=4096 --udp-timeout=60s` applied at 03:27 UTC.

Eve Chen: LB change: sessionAffinity=CLIENT_IP set for stream backend. Pushed Haproxy sticky cookie in front of LB as fallback.

ops-bot: Metric update (03:34 UTC): p99 dropped from 5.2s -> 1.4s for routes directed to eu-central1; overall p99 for eu-west2 trending to 1.8s. Streaming stall rate decreased 65%.

Liam O'Neill: NAT rotation underway for eu-west2-A: draining and replacing NAT gateway instance. Drain command: `infractl nat drain eu-west2-a --grace-period=60s`.

Priya Desai: After NAT replacement, ephemeral port errors fell to 0 and TCP retransmits normalized. VPC flow logs show packet loss returned to baseline at 03:40 UTC.

Aisha Rahman: Customer impact summary: intermittent reconnects and tails for streaming customers between 03:17-03:35 UTC; some clients reported partial message duplication on reconnect — likely due to client-side retries. No data loss in backend; telemetry shows retry loops.

Eve Chen: Root-cause hypothesis: NAT ephemeral port exhaustion in eu-west2-A combined with load-balancer affinity regression (hashing change after a config deploy) caused cross-AZ hairpin and TLS handshake thrash. Secondary contributor: DNS backoff causing some connection attempts to hit fallback IPs triggering more NAT allocation churn.

Liam O'Neill: Action items (short term): 1) Increase NAT ports permanently for eu-west2, 2) Add synthetic streaming probes across AZs and regions, 3) Revert/Audit LB hashing change and add unit test for affinity, 4) Add an automation to divert traffic when NAT error rate > threshold.

Priya Desai: I'll attach NAT logs and flow dumps to the incident ticket. Also exporting TLS handshake traces for 03:16-03:40 UTC.

Aisha Rahman: I'll prepare a customer-facing summary and notify the affected accounts. Draft will mention mitigation steps and offer follow-up call for the enterprise customer.

infra-bot: Pager rotation: Aisha Rahman -> Liam O'Neill at 03:45 UTC. Next oncall: Priya Desai 03:50-04:50 UTC.

ops-bot: Incident severity remains P1 until postmortem. Recovery window observed 03:41 UTC (all customer-facing metrics within SLOs).

Eve Chen: Scheduling post-incident RCA meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Will propose changes to LB test harness and NAT autoscaling.

Liam O'Neill: Thanks team. Follow ups created: INC-2026-3421.

Aisha Rahman: Closing thread here; will add timeline & artifacts to the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
